Proposition

1. ch8:8.19If $F\colon M\to N$ is a diffeomorphism between smooth manifolds, possibly with boundary, then every $X\in \mathfrak {X}(M)$ is $F$-related to a unique smooth vector field on $N$.

Proof

\sketch The unique possible field is

\[ Y_q=dF_{F^{-1}(q)}(X_{F^{-1}(q)}). \]

It is smooth because, as a map $N\to TN$, it is the composite

\[ N\xrightarrow {F^{-1}}M\xrightarrow {X}TM\xrightarrow {dF}TN. \]

□
